title: I got the RediSearch Install Issue with ErpNext.

posts.name: TS
posts.cooked:
I am currently working with a valid version of ERPNext and Webshop, and I am in the process of installing RediSearch on my project. Following the official documentation, it is stated that the binary file, redisearch.so, should be generated in the RediSearch/build directory after a successful build. However, despite multiple attempts, I am unable to find the redisearch.so binary file in the specified folder.

posts.cooked:
first check which redis-server version is intalled and accordingly compitable redisearch version should be used to generate redisearch.so for more details check RediSearch release notes | Docs
I have same issue resolved by following steps:
(for ubuntu 24/ redis-server 7.0.15 —> used redisearch 2.6)

  1. git clone –recursive –branch 2.6 GitHub - RediSearch/RediSearch: A query and indexing engine for Redis, providing secondary indexing, full-text search, vector similarity search and aggregations.

  2. cd RediSearch

  3. install dependencies go to .install and run the \.install.sh script with sudo

  4. then “make” in RediSearch

  5. generally on success gives the folder path of artifacts built like \home\user\RediSearch\…. in last

  6. then move redisearch.so to \etc and add “loadmodule \etc\redisearch.so” to config\redis_cache.conf before save

it should work.
